projects.title: Flock Energy Meter & Transformer Platform
projects.short_description: A take-home engineering assignment with meter and transformer dashboards, search, detail views, and CSV export.
projects.description: A take-home engineering assignment for meter and transformer management. The supplied project details describe dashboards with search and filtering, detail views, authenticated CSV exports, a responsive interface, and light and dark themes. The stated stack is React, TypeScript, Vite, Fastify, Node.js, Zod, and REST APIs. The project README describes fixture-backed data as the default, so this entry does not claim that live portal data is retrieved or that portal integration is complete.

projects.title: AI-Powered Task Management REST API
projects.short_description: A task management REST API with authenticated workflows, role-based access, and an LLM assistant.
projects.description: A Django REST Framework API backed by PostgreSQL, with a relational schema spanning at least two models and CRUD APIs for users and tasks. It uses JWT authentication and authorization across three roles, and includes an LLM assistant using LangChain and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

projects.title: Price Comparison Web App
projects.short_description: A product comparison app with search, category filters, INR pricing, and retailer links.
projects.description: A React and Express web application described as supporting product search, category filtering, INR pricing, product price comparison, responsive product grids, and retailer links. The supplied technology list includes React, Node.js, Express, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, React Router, Axios, and third-party product-data APIs. The available description does not establish that pricing is real time across every retailer.

projects.title: Shoply Clone
projects.short_description: An e-commerce application with authentication, product listings, cart, wishlist, and order management.
projects.description: An e-commerce clone described as including authentication, product listings, a shopping cart, wishlist, order management, and Stripe integration. The supplied stack is React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT, and Stripe. Production payment readiness has not been established. Repository, live-demo, and image links have not been supplied.

projects.title: Note-Taking App
projects.short_description: A full-stack note-taking app with authentication, protected routes, and note management.
projects.description: A full-stack note-taking application described as providing authentication, protected routes, note create/read/update/delete operations, a responsive interface, and theme support. The supplied stack is React, Redux Toolkit, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT, and bcryptjs. No demonstration credentials are included. Repository, live-demo, and image links have not been supplied.

projects.title: Point and Shoot — Canvas Game
projects.short_description: A browser game where players click flying ravens to score and avoid a game over.
projects.description: A browser game built with HTML5 Canvas, JavaScript, and CSS. The described gameplay asks players to click flying ravens to score, with collision detection, animated backgrounds, sound and visual effects, and a game-over state. No repository, live-demo, or image link has been supplied.

projects.title: Movie-X
projects.short_description: A responsive TMDB-powered movie and TV discovery app for searching, browsing Trending, Popular, and Top Rated titles, and viewing details.
projects.description: Movie-X is a responsive movie discovery application built with React.js and powered by the TMDB API. It lets visitors search movies and TV shows, browse Trending, Popular, and Top Rated content, and explore category pages. Detail pages present cast, crew, ratings, and related recommendations. Images are lazy-loaded. The frontend uses Redux Toolkit, React Router, JavaScript, and SCSS, and is deployed on Vercel.
